==Biography==
He is from Tübingen, Germany. On September 16, 2012 he retired from competitive gaming.<ref>[http://fnatic.com/news/10073/lamia-retires-from-gaming.html LaMia retires from gaming] ''fnatic.com''</ref> In March 2013, he joined Team Ozone Gaming and started to compete with other Taiwan LoL e-Sports teams.<ref>[http://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=568002579877159&set=a.507787002565384.117361.503701182973966 Team Ozone's Facebook Post (Taiwanese)] ''facebook.com''</ref>

== Trivia ==
* Played DotA before League of Legends. 
* He studied German, math and English to become a teacher.<ref>[http://fnatic.com/users/LaMiaZeaLoT/ Fnatic Player Profile] ''fnatic.com''</ref>
* Achieved a Pentakill at IEM World Championship with {{ci|Ashe}}.<ref>[http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_t54FlzXfvw/ IEM World Championship Ashe Pentakill! - Fnatic vs. Millenium 2012 (video)] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* Retired to move to Taiwan and learn about the Chinese language and culture.
* Introduced to [http://www.fnatic.com/content/95692/lamia-enters-the-fnatic-hall-of-fame Fnatic's Hall of Fame] on September 3, 2013.
{{PlayerStatsTrivia}}
